description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's other ability by tapping King Macar, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Pay {1} and tap Patriar's Seal to activate it's last ability, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating a Gold token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Gold token and Honor-Worn Shaku, untapping Patriar's Seal.
Activate the tapped Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2 until all opponent' creatures are exiled.
Repeat from step 2 whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
